# Aji Ceviche Bar St. Petersburg – Peruvian Restaurant

> Peruvian Restaurant in St. Petersburg, Florida. Ceviches, causas, arroces and sushi rolls. Pisco Sour to go with them.

- Areas: St. Petersburg, Gulfport, Pinellas Park, St. Pete Beach, Treasure Island
- Offers: Ceviches; Plates and rice; Drinks
